source_name: Printec Slovenija — corporate site / SI entity (PRINTEC S.I. d.o.o.)
why_relevant: The cell's anchor vendor. The SI entity PRINTEC S.I. d.o.o. is registered at Vodovodna cesta 100, Ljubljana, with ~26 employees and contact sln_info@printecgroup.com; group careers and newsroom pages are where SI-country hiring and country-manager appointments would be published.

source_name: Payten d.o.o. Slovenia (ASEE/Asseco group) — SI entity and site
why_relevant: Payten (the ASEE group's payments arm) is Printec's closest SI competitor in the ATM/POS estate: profile data states it maintains more than 32,000 POS terminals and ATMs across Slovenia, from Litostrojska cesta 44C, Ljubljana, ~31 employees, contact info@payten.si. Its hiring and management changes directly indicate which bank estates are being re-tendered or expanded.

source_name: ASEE / Asseco South Eastern Europe — group site and careers
why_relevant: ASEE Group (Warsaw-listed, founded 2007, ~2,900 staff across 23 countries, comprising Asseco SEE and Payten) is the parent of the SI Payten entity and a top regional core-banking/digital-banking supplier. Group career postings and investor communications carry country-level appointments and delivery-centre moves that never appear in SI media.

source_name: Comtrade (Slovenia) — employer pages and SI entity
why_relevant: Comtrade Group has a divisional head office in Ljubljana and ~500 staff across Ljubljana, Maribor and Nova Gorica; public descriptions state a share of that workforce builds banking-sector and telecom solutions. Its SI job ads are a direct read on which bank-facing development lines are staffing up.

source_name: Endava — Ljubljana location and careers/job search
why_relevant: Endava d.o.o. operates a Ljubljana nearshore delivery centre (Vilharjeva cesta 46) with ~231 staff per D&B; Endava's payments/banking practice means its SI headcount and role mix is a leading indicator of outsourced bank delivery work landing in Slovenia. Its jobs portal exposes per-location openings.

source_name: NCR Atleos — corporate leadership and LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: NCR Atleos is the ATM/self-service incumbent selling into SI banks. No SI country-manager announcement was found this run, so the practical route is the corporate leadership/news pages plus the LinkedIn company page, where regional appointments are posted even when there is no press release. Corporate-level M&A (a reported Brink's interest in NCR Atleos) also reshuffles country ownership.

source_name: ATM Marketplace — ATM/self-service vendor trade media
why_relevant: Sector trade outlet that profiles and compares ATM manufacturers (NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf, Hyosung, GRG, etc.) and reports channel/leadership changes. Useful for catching regional distributor and country-management shifts affecting the Adriatic before local media notice.

source_name: American Banker / PaymentsSource — ATM & payments vendor coverage
why_relevant: Reports strategy and leadership shifts at NCR/NCR Atleos and Diebold Nixdorf (e.g. new-boss coverage, Brink's plan to buy NCR Atleos). Corporate-level ownership change is the upstream cause of country-manager churn and delivery-model changes in small markets like Slovenia.

source_name: LinkedIn — SI vendor company pages and people-change signals
why_relevant: For private SI suppliers, LinkedIn is where country-manager appointments, new-hire announcements and delivery-centre openings are actually announced; company pages exist for Bankart, NCR Atleos and effectively all cell actors. Highest-yield channel for 'leadership moves' in this cell.

source_name: University career channels — FMF/FRI job postings from banking-IT employers
why_relevant: SI banking-IT employers recruit graduates directly through faculty noticeboards — a confirmed Bankart posting sits on the University of Ljubljana FMF notices page. These postings often predate public job ads and name the specific technology stack being built.

source_name: BetterCareer.si — Slovenian IT-company employer directory
why_relevant: A curated directory of Slovenian IT companies with employer profiles; useful as a pointer to expand the cell's actor map beyond the seeded vendor names (smaller SI integrators and fintech dev shops that also sell into banks).

source_name: Kompass Slovenia / iTIS Siol business directories
why_relevant: Directory listings give address, activity classification and sometimes contact-person names for SI vendor entities (confirmed Payten d.o.o. entries on both si.kompass.com and itis.siol.net). Cheap way to enumerate lesser-known integrators by SKD activity code before profiling them.

source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo Group Newsroom - press releases (International Subsidiary Banks Division)
why_relevant: Milan HQ is the issuing authority for CEO/board appointments at Banka Intesa Sanpaolo d.d. Slovenia. Confirmed pattern: the appointment of Mojca Kovac as CEO of Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenia (and Pal Simak's move to Milan) was announced by the Group newsroom, not primarily by the Slovenian bank. This is the canonical first-publication point for SI leadership moves in this ownership chain.

source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo Group Newsroom - 'all news' feed (subsidiary-level items)
why_relevant: Subsidiary-country leadership items frequently appear under 'all-news' rather than the formal press-release stream, which means a collector watching only /press-releases will systematically miss Slovenian CEO changes.

source_name: Banka Intesa Sanpaolo d.d. (SI) - aktualne objave / novosti in publikacije
why_relevant: Local mirror/complement of group announcements; also carries AGM convocations (sklic skupscine) and supervisory-board decisions that reveal board composition changes before or after the Milan release.

source_name: OTP banka d.d. (Slovenia) - Press releases (EN)
why_relevant: The merged Nova KBM + SKB entity under OTP Group publishes management-board nominations and appointments in English here, including supervisory-board nominations subject to Bank of Slovenia approval. Highest-volume single feed for SI bank leadership changes in the OTP chain.

source_name: OTP banka d.d. - Uprava banke / Management board page
why_relevant: Authoritative current-state roster with mandate start dates and portfolio split (e.g. John Denhof as president since 23 Aug 2024, Anita Stojcevska responsible for corporates). Diffing this page detects changes even when no press release is issued.

source_name: OTP Group (Budapest HQ) newsroom
why_relevant: Budapest HQ issues the group-level view of Slovenian entity milestones (acquisition approvals, merger completion, country-CEO designation). Csanyi's announcement of the merged-bank leadership was made at group level. Complements, and sometimes precedes, the SI subsidiary feed.

source_name: Addiko Bank AG - Investor Relations (ad-hoc / corporate news)
why_relevant: Vienna-listed parent of Addiko Bank d.d. Ljubljana. Country-CEO and executive-board changes across CSEE subsidiaries are disclosed as ad-hoc/corporate news and PTA releases (e.g. the July 2026 organisational update covering an executive departure with continuity language for local entities). Regulated disclosure = high evidentiary value.

source_name: PTA / pressetext ad-hoc distribution (Austrian issuer releases)
why_relevant: Austrian-parent issuers (Addiko, Steiermaerkische-linked entities, VIG) distribute ad-hoc and corporate news via PTA; the wire copy is often indexed and retrievable when the issuer site is bot-defended, and carries the exact original German/English wording.

source_name: Banka Sparkasse d.d. (SI) - Novice / sporocila za javnost
why_relevant: The Slovenian Steiermaerkische/Erste-affiliated bank publishes dated management-board change releases in Slovenian (e.g. 'Spremembe v upravi Banke Sparkasse d.d.' in Jan 2021 and Jan 2022). Directly on-topic and consistently local-language only.

source_name: Steiermaerkische Sparkasse - Vorstand and Aufsichtsrat pages (Graz parent)
why_relevant: Graz parent of Banka Sparkasse d.d. and of the CSEE holding structure. The Vorstand/Aufsichtsrat pages disclose who at parent level owns the Slovenian market, and the Sparkassenrat appointment mechanism (max five-year terms) is documented here - useful for anticipating renewal windows.

source_name: Erste Group Bank AG - Press releases and archive
why_relevant: Erste Group sits above the Sparkasse network including Slovenia and issues group-wide organisational and brand/structure announcements that reach the Slovenian entity. The archive path allows historical reconstruction of organisational changes.

source_name: Nexi Group - Media relations / press releases archive
why_relevant: Payments-side parent for the Slovenian acquiring/issuing business (Nexi Croatia/Slovenia leadership is held jointly). Group PR is where country general-manager appointments are announced, following the pattern observed for Nexi Switzerland; Slovenia-specific items are rarer, so also monitor group governance PDFs.

source_name: Vienna Insurance Group (VIG) - Press centre
why_relevant: Bank-assurance parent with Slovenian market presence via a Wiener Staedtische branch. Managing-board changes at group and at Wiener Staedtische level are announced here and cascade to the Slovenian branch's reporting line; the 'Markets' page documents the SI operating form.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Slovenija - notranje upravljanje (internal governance) disclosures
why_relevant: Mandatory internal-governance disclosure page listing management and supervisory bodies for the SI subsidiary of UniCredit; the regulatory-driven update cadence makes it a reliable change detector even without a press release. Complements the leasing arm, whose regional reporting line (Croatia/Slovenia/Serbia/BiH) is set at regional level.

source_name: Slovenian business media coverage of foreign-parent leadership moves (Delo, Vecer, RTV SLO, Siol, 24ur)
why_relevant: Where the HQ release is in Hungarian/Italian/German or is delivered only at a press conference, Slovenian outlets are often the only accessible record - e.g. the Maribor press conference at which OTP's chairman named the merged bank's leadership, and Vecer's reporting of the new Sparkasse board. Useful as a discovery tripwire pointing back to primary releases.
